text: Of David. I will praise you, O Lord, with all my heart; before the “gods” I will sing your praise.
and will praise your name for your love and your faithfulness, for you have exalted above all things your name and your word.
you made me bold and stouthearted.
when they hear the words of your mouth.
for the glory of the Lord is great.
but the proud he knows from afar.
you preserve my life; you stretch out your hand against the anger of my foes, with your right hand you save me.
your love, O Lord, endures forever— do not abandon the works of your hands.
